headshotMethod: Each displayed portrait was visually inspected alongside a separately attributed NBA reference. A different photo or reference silhouette stays open unless a named publisher independently verifies the selected asset. Hashes identify the inspected files.
statAuditMethod: Recomputed points, rebounds and assists from 210 final NBA regular-season box scores for October 20–November 17. Matched NBA person ID, counted appearances with a minutes-and-seconds entry, and rounded the total divided by games to one decimal, using round-half-up. The officialBoxes index links each contributing game ID to its verified final box. Compared against the dated site dataset and the official NBA player season profile. For the four non-rounding cases, also checked individual player rows in the SportsDataverse ESPN 2026–27 parquet file.

resumeInstructions: Read both trackers from the same current main commit. Compare deepReviewCompletedIds with every approved status and retain the approved reports and 50 original spotlight entries.

Select 25–40 pending IDs grouped by team, checking expanded drafts first. Independently check dated season totals, game evidence, current teammates, historical and postseason claims. Record evidence URLs per report.

Compare the actual displayed headshot with an independently attributed official image. Keep unknown or insufficient images open. Reconcile stats against official regular-season game results for the same cutoff and count appearances with playing time, including sub-minute appearances.

Review each player for specific offensive and defensive mechanisms, individual role, limitations, teammate fit, development and a detailed original verdict. Commit both trackers together. Check live data and the actual Player File renderer before reporting progress.
